# Coconote

> > Coconote is an AI-powered note-taking application that automatically generates flashcards, quizzes, and study tools from your notes to enhance learning and retention.

Coconote serves students and learners by transforming notes into interactive study materials using AI. The platform offers multilingual support, transcription capabilities, and an intelligent assistant to help users study more effectively.

## Key Topics

- AI note-taking
- Flashcard generation
- Quiz creation
- Study tools
- Multilingual support
- Transcription
- AI assistant
- Student learning
- Note organization
- Educational technology
- Automated study materials
- Learning retention
